d:
The protest by BPSC aspirants in Bihar continues to gain momentum. On the streets of Patna, young candidates are fighting for their rights, transparency, and future—each carrying a story of struggle and resilience.
​In this ground report, listen to the powerful story of a female BPSC aspirant sitting on a hunger strike. Having joined the demonstration without even informing her family back home, she shares her emotional journey, the struggle to answer her mother's calls, and her determination to see justice delivered.
